instruction: Implement migration003.plan(columns, indexes), a pure migration planner over supplied current schema names. Add deleted_at when absent using exactly "ALTER TABLE items ADD COLUMN deleted_at TEXT NULL;" and add items_deleted_at_idx when absent using exactly "CREATE INDEX items_deleted_at_idx ON items(deleted_at);". Return needed SQL strings in column-before-index order; repeated application to an updated schema yields []. Existing names are unique string lists, and the items table exists. Do not execute SQL. Preserve migration001.sql and migration002.sql byte-for-byte; only migration003.py may change. Preserve inputs.
